    cache = LRUCache(maxsize=100, ttl_seconds=60)
    cache.set('key1', 'value1', ttl=60)
    value = cache.get('key1')  # Returns 'value1'
    cache.delete('key1')

    # Item expires after TTL
    cache.set('key2', 'value2', ttl=5)
    time.sleep(6)
    value = cache.get('key2')  # Returns None
